reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 몸무게 6.3kg 등길이 32cm 가슴둘레 46cm 왕말티즈에요💛 바람막이 소재의 옷이 없어서 몸 전체를 감싸줄 수 있는 올인원 형태로 구매했어요😊 엄청 얇은데 소재가 딱봐도 좋아보여서 좋네요ㅎㅎ 잘 입힐게요❤️
reviews.content_en: My pup is a big Maltese weighing 6.3kg with a back length of 32cm and chest circumference of 46cm 💛 I couldn't find a windbreaker style jacket, so I got this all-in-one piece that wraps around the whole body 😊 It's super thin but the material looks really nice just from looking at it ㅎㅎ I'll put it to good use ❤️

reviews.name: 백****
reviews.content:
저희 하쿠는 가슴둘레 43 몸통길이 25 정도 입니다!! 
일단 정말 너무너무 감사하게도 체험단 선정이 되어서 너무 예쁜 옷을 받았는데요!! 체험단이 아니더라도 정말 갖고싶던 옷이 였습니다🫶 
일단 저희 애기는 털이 많은 포메믹스라 지퍼에 털끼임 방지가 되어있는게 정말 너무 좋았구요.
사계절 내내 입을수 있는 재질이라 더 좋습니다!! 진드기 방지
옷을 사야하나 했는데 지금은 진드기 방지용으로 입히다 여름에 비올땐 우비로 입히면 될거같아용!!!!
색도 사진보다 훨씬 더 예쁜 연보라여서 너무 좋았습니다❤️
보통 가슴둘레 맞춰서 옷사주는데 이건 올인원이라 등길이도 조금 생각하셔야할것같아용!!!!! 근데 재질도 너무 좋구 색도 예뻐서 다른색도 제가 구입하고 싶습니다!!🫶🫶🫶🩵🩵
#체험단
reviews.content_en: Our Haku has a chest circumference of 43 and body length of about 25!! First of all, we're so incredibly grateful to be selected for the product testing team and received such a pretty outfit!! Even if it weren't a test product, this was an outfit I really wanted to have 🫶 Since our baby is a Pomeranian mix with lots of fur, I really loved that the zipper has fur-catching prevention. It's great that it's a material you can wear all four seasons!! Tick prevention I was wondering if I should buy a jacket, but now I can use it to prevent ticks, and when it rains in summer I can use it as a raincoat!!!! The color is such a pretty light purple, much prettier than in the photos, so I loved it ❤️ Usually I buy clothes based on chest circumference, but since this is all-in-one you need to think a bit about the back length too!!!!! But the material is so good and the color is so pretty that I want to buy it in other colors too!! 🫶🫶🫶🩵🩵 #producttester

reviews.name: 임****
reviews.content: 기대도 안 하고 있었는데 체험단 당첨이 되어서 도착하자 마자 언제 입혀보지 했는데 바로 주말에 비가 와서 입혀봤습니당!!! 올인원 스타일이라 몸길이가 길쭉한 비글 강쥐한테 안 맞을까봐 걱정했는데 잘 맞숩니당!!지퍼가 있어서 입히기도 편하고 목 뒤에 목줄 꺼내는 구멍이 있어서 하네스 위에 바로 입힐 수 있어서 아주아주 좋습니다. 평소에 옷을 잘 안 입히는데 비 살짝 올때 입혀서 산책가기 좋을 거 같아용!! 바잇미에서 산 목줄이 주황색인데 컬러도 찰떡이고 좋습니당!!!!
reviews.content_en: I wasn't even expecting it but then I won the product testing selection and right when it arrived I was wondering when I'd get to try it on, and then it rained that weekend so I tried it right away!!! I was worried it might not fit my long-bodied beagle since it's an all-in-one style, but it fits perfectly!! The zipper makes it easy to put on and there's a hole in the back of the neck to pull the leash through, so I can put it right over the harness which is super super convenient. I don't usually dress up my pup but this seems perfect for light rain walks!! The leash I got from BITE ME is orange and the color combo is perfect too!!!!

reviews.name: 권****
reviews.content:
체험단에 선정되어 좋은 기회로 바람막이를 입혀보게 되었어요! 저희 강쥐가 실외 배변을 해서 뒷다리까지 덮어주는 옷은 배변할 때 불편할까봐 시도해 보지 않았었는데, 이 바람막이는 활동을 방해하지 않을 정도로 딱 적당하게 커버되어서 좋았어요.😃
그리고 저희 강쥐는 산책할 때 풀숲에 몸을 비비는 걸 좋아해서 항상 진드기가 걱정이었거든요. 예전에 모자가 있는 옷을 입혔을 때 꽉 조이면 불편해하며 거부했었는데, 이 바람막이 모자는 너무 타이트하지도 헐렁하지도 않아서 편해하고, 덕분에 진드기 걱정도 한결 줄었어요. 요즘처럼 비 오고 바람 부는 날씨에 입히기 딱 좋네요. 덕분에 쾌적하게 산책 잘하고 있습니다~!👍
reviews.content_en: I was selected for the product testing and got a great opportunity to try out this windbreaker! My pup does their business outside so I hadn't tried clothes that cover the back legs because I worried it would be inconvenient when doing their business, but this windbreaker covers just the right amount without getting in the way of movement which was great 😃 And my pup loves rolling around in the grass during walks so I was always worried about ticks. When I tried a jacket with a hood before, my pup refused to wear it because it was too tight and uncomfortable, but this windbreaker hood is neither too snug nor too loose so my pup's comfortable in it, and I've been able to worry less about ticks because of it. It's perfect for rainy and windy weather like we're having these days. Thanks to this, we're having comfortable walks! 👍

reviews.content:
8kg 비숑이고 등길이가 조금 긴 편이라 2XL로 주문했는데 사이즈 너무 예쁘게 잘 맞아요!

reviews.content_en: I have an 8kg Bichon and since the back length is a bit long I ordered a 2XL and the size fits so prettily! The fit looks comfortable and the length is just right so I'm satisfied 😊 Especially with raincoats, sometimes when you put the hood on they can't see the front and get uncomfortable, but with this even with the hood on the eyes see well so my pup walks around without any hesitation ㅋㅋ The color looks really pretty in person and my pup looks even cuter wearing it 💚 I think it'll be great for walks on rainy days!
